[{"name":"covis_cart","idea":"Item to item table of items carted or ordered within 20 events of the item in the same history session over the last 14 days; orders weigh double and each session counts once per pair.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, seq, event FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400), b AS (SELECT session, item, seq, CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END AS w FROM h WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order')), d AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, b.item AS item2, max(b.w) AS w FROM h a JOIN b ON b.session = a.session AND b.item <> a.item AND b.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 20 AND a.seq + 20 GROUP BY a.session, a.item, b.item), p AS (SELECT item, item2, sum(w) AS tv_w, count(*) AS tv_ns FROM d GROUP BY item, item2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, tv_w, tv_ns, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY tv_w DESC, tv_ns DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, tv_w, tv_ns FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"},
{"name":"covis_next","idea":"Directed next-item transitions in the last 7 days of history: items that follow the item within 3 events of the same session, weighted by 1/distance.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, seq FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400), p AS (SELECT a.item, b.item AS item2, sum(1.0 / (b.seq - a.seq)) AS tv_w, count(*) AS tv_n FROM h a JOIN h b ON b.session = a.session AND b.seq BETWEEN a.seq + 1 AND a.seq + 3 AND b.item <> a.item GROUP BY a.item, b.item HAVING count(*) >= 2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, tv_w, tv_n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY tv_w DESC, tv_n DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, tv_w, tv_n FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"},
{"name":"buy2buy","idea":"Item to item table of items carted or ordered together (within 50 events) in the same history session over the last 14 days, counted once per session.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH b AS (SELECT session, item, seq FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400 AND event IN ('cart', 'order')), d AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.session, x.item, y.item AS item2 FROM b x JOIN b y ON y.session = x.session AND y.item <> x.item AND y.seq BETWEEN x.seq - 50 AND x.seq + 50), p AS (SELECT item, item2, count(*) AS tv_ns FROM d GROUP BY item, item2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, tv_ns, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY tv_ns DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, tv_ns FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"},
{"name":"wk_covis","idea":"Current-week co-visitation: items seen within 5 events of the session's last 5 prefix items in other target-week prefixes, weighted by recency rank and excluding items already in the prefix.","kind":"source","level":"pair","sql":"WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rp FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rp) AS rp FROM lp WHERE rp <= 5 GROUP BY session, item), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) AS c FROM a JOIN sess y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 5 AND a.seq + 5 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, pr.dst AS item, sum(pr.c / li.rp) AS score FROM li JOIN pr ON pr.src = li.item GROUP BY li.session, pr.dst), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = sc.session AND z.item = sc.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;"},
{"name":"hist_next","idea":"Items that followed the session's last 3 prefix items within 3 events in history sessions of the last 7 days, with carts and orders of the follower weighted higher, excluding items already in the prefix.","kind":"source","level":"pair","sql":"WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rp FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rp) AS rp FROM lp WHERE rp <= 3 GROUP BY session, item), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM hist x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) + 2.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.event <> 'view' THEN y.session END) AS c FROM a JOIN hist y ON y.session = a.session AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq + 1 AND a.seq + 3 AND y.item <> a.item WHERE y.ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, pr.dst AS item, sum(pr.c / li.rp) AS score FROM li JOIN pr ON pr.src = li.item GROUP BY li.session, pr.dst), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess z WHERE z.session = sc.session AND z.item = sc.item)), rk AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS r FROM f) SELECT session, item, score FROM rk WHERE r <= 40;"}]
